description: Price delivery of a cart from one rikma to an address — "how much is delivery to Haifa?". Give the products (and variant when the product has variants) with quantities, and the address (city is enough inside Israel; the district is resolved from it). Unit prices are read from the rikma's own catalog, so free-delivery thresholds apply as at checkout. Returns every option (delivery methods, pickup points, digital, "contact the seller") with fee, whether it is free, how much more makes it free, ETA and next dispatch day, plus why delivery is unavailable (outsideZones, noDeliveryProducts, needsAddress, weightUnknown). Members only; read-only — nothing is ordered. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#quoteShippingTool

address.description: Where it goes. Omit to see pickup/digital options and which methods would need an address.

city.description: City name, in any language the buyer wrote it.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. IL. Default IL.

variantId.description: Variant id, when the product is sold by variant (from listRikmaProducts).

name: quoteShippingTool
